name: Inoue Suzu
source:
A brilliant young girl with a flair for mad inventions, Suzu's at her happiest tinkering away, wrench in hand, down at the motorcycle shop. Her overly scientific curiosity can sometimes make for awkward social moments

[from [url=http://www.shira-oka.com/characters/13-inoue-suzu.html]official site[/url]]
